an6.111:1.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya tayo dhammā bhāvetabbā.
an6.111:1.7: kāmadhātuyā pahānāya nekkhammadhātu bhāvetabbā. vyāpādadhātuyā pahānāya avyāpādadhātu bhāvetabbā. vihiṃsādhātuyā pahānāya avihiṃsā dhātu bhāvetabbā
an6.111:1.8: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya ime tayo dhammā bhāvetabbāti.
